notes.title: Performance optimization
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428356/00a71f05baeaffc31b1b321762b2ff4e95bd5bb4.png


 Performance optimization

In the previous version, there was a lot of meaningless performance overhead. This update solves the problem of excessive performance usage and adjusts the frame rate to an appropriate range.

"Another World - Thought Taboo" has been launched for a month, thank you for your support during this time~

notes.title: Unexpected BUG fixes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428356/00a71f05baeaffc31b1b321762b2ff4e95bd5bb4.png


 The game doesn't work properly after the battle
(This problem has been bothering me, now that the order of execution is optimized, this error is resolved)

I hope there will be no new bugs in this adjustment~

notes.title: Pharmacist's after-sales service
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428356/00a71f05baeaffc31b1b321762b2ff4e95bd5bb4.png


 Tips for the effect of medicine after use
(It seems that our pharmacist has realized that something is wrong, now after you drink the potion carefully prepared by the pharmacist, she will tell you about your physical condition)

Here are her words：

My guests have always been very satisfied with the potions I brewed, and they even passed out with joy, which makes me very gratified~

notes.title: Optimized loading speed & vampire enhancements
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428356/00a71f05baeaffc31b1b321762b2ff4e95bd5bb4.png


 Optimized the loading speed when switching scenes
(Obviously, the timing of the scene cuts was a bit of a drag, but that's fixed now!)

 Vampires are enhanced
(Increased vampire's luck, guards are not as easy to catch it as before...)

notes.title: Optimize experience & fix BUG
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428356/00a71f05baeaffc31b1b321762b2ff4e95bd5bb4.png


 Adjusted rewards for participating in illegal work
(This job pays more!)

 Aging penalty reduced
(It seems that it is not a good thing for the brave to age too fast)

 Increased experience gained in battle
(This should make you feel better...)

 Fix bugs in gambling games
(A simple display error~)

notes.title: Version update & optimize experience & fix BUG
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428356/00a71f05baeaffc31b1b321762b2ff4e95bd5bb4.png


 Updated the ability to predict enemy actions during battle
(I think this feature is super cool!)

 Optimized the playback speed and effects of the text to make it smoother
(After receiving feedback from everyone, I feel that it really needs to be optimized)

 Fixed a bug where some texts were displayed incorrectly
([strike]I don't know what it does, but the bug seems to mysteriously disappear[/strike])

 Fixed an issue where localized translations were not displaying correctly
(It's hidden too deep, and it's not the reason I wasn't careful enough...)

 Fixed an issue where display errors occurred when switching resolutions
(My brain is attacking me and telling me how to fix it...)


Thank you very much for your support
